subject: Advanced Database
title: Summative Exam: SQL, JOINs, Backup & Node.js

questions.text: Which of the following best describes the Node.js event loop?
options: It blocks the thread while waiting for database queries.
It uses a single thread to handle multiple I/O operations asynchronously.
It creates a new thread for every incoming request.
It is a multi-threaded execution model designed for CPU-intensive tasks.
questions.hint: Think about how Node.js handles I/O operations without waiting.

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a database backup?
options: To create a copy of data for protection against loss.
To encrypt the data for security.
questions.hint: Consider why we create copies of data.

questions.text: Which JOIN returns all rows from the left table and only the matching rows from the right table?
questions.hint: Which table is prioritized to keep all its rows?

questions.text: In Node.js, which built-in module is used to create an HTTP server?
questions.hint: This module handles networking and web requests.

questions.text: Which command-line tool is commonly used to back up a MySQL database?
questions.hint: It is a standard tool that comes with MySQL for dumping data.

questions.text: In the MVC pattern, which component is responsible for handling user input and updating the Model and View?
questions.hint: This component acts as the intermediary.

questions.text: What SQL keyword is used to specify the condition for joining two tables?
questions.hint: It typically follows the JOIN clause.

questions.text: Which method is used to stop a running Node.js server in the terminal?
questions.hint: It sends a SIGINT signal to the process.

questions.text: What is the process of restoring a database from a backup to its previous state called?
questions.hint: This is the opposite of backup.

questions.text: In an MVC application, where should the business logic primarily reside?
questions.hint: This component interacts directly with the database.

questions.text: What is the purpose of the `package.json` file in a Node.js project?
options: To manage project metadata and dependencies.
To define the routing for the application.
questions.hint: It is the manifest file for the project.

questions.text: Which PHP function is used to execute an external shell command like `mysqldump`?
questions.hint: This function is often used to run system utilities.

questions.text: What does the `FULL OUTER JOIN` return?
options: Only matching rows from both tables.
All rows from the left table and matching rows from the right.
All rows from both tables, with NULL where there is no match.
All rows from the right table and matching rows from the left.
questions.hint: It combines the results of both LEFT and RIGHT JOINs.

questions.text: What is the correct way to import a core module like `http` in Node.js?
questions.hint: Node.js uses the CommonJS standard by default.

questions.text: In the context of MVC, what is the primary role of the View component?
options: To present data to the user.
questions.hint: It is the user interface layer.

questions.text: Node.js is a programming language, not a runtime environment.
questions.hint: Node.js executes JavaScript.

questions.text: An `INNER JOIN` returns all rows from both tables, even if they don't match.
questions.hint: This JOIN only returns matching rows.

questions.text: A database backup is only important for large enterprises and not for small applications.
questions.hint: Data loss can be catastrophic for any application.

questions.text: In MVC, the Controller is responsible for rendering HTML to the user.
questions.hint: This is the responsibility of the View.

questions.text: The `res.end()` method is used to signal the end of an HTTP response in Node.js.
questions.hint: It finalizes the response.

questions.text: The process of creating a copy of a database or its components to protect against data loss is called _______.
questions.hint: This is the first step in a recovery strategy.

questions.text: A SQL JOIN type that returns all rows from the left table and matching rows from the right table is known as a _______ JOIN.
questions.hint: The keyword is also used to describe the side that gets all rows.

questions.text: The built-in Node.js module for handling file system operations is called _______.
questions.hint: It stands for File System.

questions.text: In MVC, the component that represents the user interface and displays data to the user is the _______.
questions.hint: It is the presentation layer.

questions.text: A standard file extension used for SQL database backup scripts is ______.
questions.hint: This is a plain-text file containing SQL commands.

questions.text: The `_______` command is used to run a JavaScript file with Node.js.
questions.hint: It is the runtime command for executing scripts.

questions.text: In a SQL JOIN statement, the condition that specifies how to link two tables is placed after the _______ keyword.
questions.hint: It follows the JOIN clause.

questions.text: The _______ pattern separates an application into three interconnected components: Model, View, and Controller.
questions.hint: It's an acronym for a popular architectural pattern.

questions.text: The command used to import a backup file into a MySQL database via the command line is _______.
questions.hint: This is the client program that connects to the database server.

questions.text: The _______ method is called on a Node.js HTTP server object to start accepting connections on a specified port.
questions.hint: It binds the server to a network port.
